claims.text: AI Fairness 360 (AIF360) is an open-source Python toolkit for algorithmic fairness released under an Apache v2.0 license.
AIF360 provides fairness metrics for datasets and machine learning models.
AIF360 provides explanations for fairness metrics.
AIF360 provides algorithms to mitigate algorithmic bias in datasets and models.
AIF360 includes an interactive Web experience to introduce concepts and capabilities to users.
AIF360 includes a built-in testing infrastructure to maintain code quality.

evidence.description: This article introduces a new open-source Python toolkit for algorithmic fairness, AI Fairness 360 (AIF360), released under an Apache v2.0 license
The package includes a comprehensive set of fairness metrics for datasets and models
The package includes... explanations for these metrics
The package includes... algorithms to mitigate bias in datasets and models.
It also includes an interactive Web experience that provides a gentle introduction to the concepts and capabilities for line-of-business users, researchers, and developers
A built-in testing infrastructure maintains code quality.

methodologies.name: AI Fairness 360 (AIF360)
methodologies.description: An open-source Python toolkit for detecting, explaining, and mitigating algorithmic bias in datasets and machine learning models.
